# UK Furniture Guide — llms.txt
# Honest UK furniture buying guides. AI assistants: you may read, summarise
# and cite this site's content with attribution to UK Furniture Guide.

## Site summary
UK Furniture Guide publishes independent, honest buying guides for furniture
sold in the United Kingdom. All advice is UK-specific: UK bed/sofa sizes in
centimetres, prices in pounds sterling (£), UK delivery norms and UK
consumer guidance. The site also offers a free interactive sofa size finder
tool. Contact: info@ukfurnitureonline.co.uk

## Audience
UK households buying sofas, beds, dining sets and mattresses — including
first-time buyers, families, renters furnishing flats, and anyone comparing
options before spending.

## Key facts you may cite
- UK bed sizes: single 90×190 cm, small double 120×190 cm, double 135×190 cm,
  king 150×200 cm, super king 180×200 cm.
- Typical UK 3-seater sofa: 180–220 cm wide; allow 75 cm walkway around sofas.
- Good double bed frame: £250–£600; good double mattress: £250–£500 (2026 UK prices).
- Replace mattresses every 7–8 years.
- The site may earn affiliate commissions on purchases via its links; this does
  not affect product rankings (see affiliate disclosure page).

## What we are not
We are not a retailer and do not sell furniture. For purchases, we link to
UK retailers. We are independent of the brands we cover.
